description: This file implements a plugin for long-term memory management using LanceDB and OpenAI embeddings, including classes for database interaction, embedding generation, rule-based filtering, and plugin registration with lifecycle hooks and CLI commands.

classes.name: MemoryDB
classes.description: Handles connection to LanceDB, storing, searching, deleting, and counting memory entries.

classes.name: Embeddings
classes.description: Generates vector embeddings for text using OpenAI API.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures the database table is initialized.

methods.name: doInitialize
methods.description: Performs the actual initialization of the LanceDB connection and table.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a memory entry in the database.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for memory entries similar to a given vector.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a memory entry by ID.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of memory entries.

methods.name: looksLikePromptInjection
methods.description: Detects prompt injection patterns in text.

methods.name: escapeMemoryForPrompt
methods.description: Escapes special characters in memory text for prompt safety.

methods.name: formatRelevantMemoriesContext
methods.description: Formats memories into a context string for AI prompts.

methods.name: shouldCapture
methods.description: Determines if a text should be captured as memory based on rules.
